title: Icon: Glyph cache (pre-rendered bitmap cache with LRU)
acceptance_criteria: glyph_cache struct: entries array with codepoint, bitmap, texture, last_used
cache_init(max_entries) allocates cache with configurable size
cache_get(codepoint) returns cached bitmap or NULL if miss
cache_put(codepoint, bitmap) stores rendered glyph, evicts LRU entry if full
Cache hit rate tracked for performance monitoring
LRU eviction: least recently used entry replaced on cache full
Bitmap data stored in GPU texture (sokol_gfx image) when possible
Unit test verifies cache hit/miss behavior and LRU eviction order
